blocks.text: WE ARE CYBORG is an ongoing photographic project examining how digital infrastructures increasingly shape human identity, perception and communication.

The chapter FACES combines portrait photography with macro photographs of real computer motherboards. Each portrait is connected to a single motherboard, creating hybrid faces in which human presence and technological structure become visually inseparable. The works do not imagine a distant science-fiction future. Instead, they reflect a condition that already belongs to the present.

The series neither celebrates nor condemns technology. It approaches the growing entanglement of humans and machines as a reality to be critically observed: how far do technological systems enter the body, perception and identity, and what remains distinctly human once this process has already begun?

I spent 13 years working within the Formula 1 environment, where I experienced first-hand how closely human performance and technological systems can merge. That experience later became one of the starting points for WE ARE CYBORG.

The submitted selection focuses on FACES as the first completed chapter of the project and is extended by a small number of installation and exhibition views that show the works as physical objects in space.
